name: Corrahn's Dagger
summary: Syndicate cutthroats hold Corrahn's Dagger, the second ridge among northern Hillsbrad's four rocky fingers. They use its high ground as a hideout.

sections.title: A Northern Strongpoint
sections.body: Corrahn's Dagger rises in northern Hillsbrad Foothills as the second of four rocky ridges called the fingers of Hillsbrad. Syndicate cutthroats overrun the ridge and use its height to watch the valley below.

faq.answer: Rogue humans of the Syndicate hold Corrahn's Dagger and use its heights as a hideout.

faq.q: What are the fingers of Hillsbrad?
faq.answer: The fingers of Hillsbrad are four prominent ridges that project south from the northern mountain range into Hillsbrad valley. Corrahn's Dagger is the second ridge.

angles.text: As a dwarf crossing the northern foothills, expect bandits rather than allies at this Syndicate hideout.
As Forsaken working in Hillsbrad, you face hostility from the Syndicate cutthroats on the ridge.
